_comment: Wyvrn harness hook template. Merge the `hooks` key into your own ~/.claude/settings.json - do not replace the file, it also holds your permissions, plugins, and model. Replace <YOUR-HOME> in both commands with your home directory, using forward slashes (e.g. C:/Users/you) so no backslash escaping is needed. PreToolUse: refuses any Bash or PowerShell tool call while a process named in <project>/.claude-wyvrn-local/build-lock-processes is alive (plain text, one process name per line, e.g. cmake/ninja/ctest for a C++ project), so two toolchain invocations can never overlap; a project without the file is never blocked. Concurrent build/test runs have hard-crashed developer machines. PostToolUse: runs clang-format on edited C++ sources only, and no-ops with one warning if clang-format is not on PATH.
_caveat_file_not_command: Both hooks MUST be wired with -File pointing at the shipped script, never an inline -Command. Claude Code passes the hook `command` string through a POSIX shell before running it, and that shell strips PowerShell's `$var`, `$env:VAR` and `$_`. An inline -Command body therefore reaches powershell.exe mangled, dies with a parse error, and exits 1 - which for a PreToolUse hook means the lock silently never blocks anything. Earlier versions of this template shipped the inline form and did exactly that.
_caveat_pretooluse: The lock blocks EVERY Bash and PowerShell tool call while a listed process is running, not just build commands - including the in-session command that would kill a stale orphan. If you get stuck, sweep from a terminal outside Claude Code: Get-Process <listed names> | Stop-Process -Force
_caveat_process_names: Names are matched the way Get-Process matches them: no .exe suffix. `cmake` blocks, `cmake.exe` matches nothing and silently never blocks. Wildcards (`test_*`) work. Lines starting with # are comments.
_caveat_not_a_mutex: This is a poll at tool-call time, not a held lock. Two sessions that start a build in the same instant both pass the check. It catches an already-running build, not a simultaneous start.
